using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.server;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class SingleDatabaseManagerTests
    {
        // Helper to create a SingleDatabaseManager with minimal dependencies
        private SingleDatabaseManager CreateManager()
        {
            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>(null, null);
            storeWrapperMock.SetupGet(s => s.loggerFactory).Returns(new LoggerFactory());
            return new SingleDatabaseManager(dbId => new GarnetDatabase(0), storeWrapperMock.Object, createDefaultDatabase: true);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsInformationWhenAofSizeExceedsLimit()
        {
            // Arrange
            var manager = CreateManager();

            // Setup a mock logger to capture LogInformation calls
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();

            // We need to simulate AppendOnlyFile.TailAddress and BeginAddress to control aofSize
            // Since AppendOnlyFile is not accessible, we will test the method as-is and rely on the logger call

            // Act
            // We call with aofSizeLimit = 0 to force the condition aofSize > aofSizeLimit
            await manager.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(0, CancellationToken.None, loggerMock.Object);

            // Assert
            // Verify that LogInformation was called with the expected message template and parameters
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Enforcing AOF size limit")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}

            {
            }

            // Expose AppendOnlyFile TailAddress and BeginAddress for testing

            public long BeginAddress { get; set; }

            // Override AppendOnlyFile to simulate TailAddress and BeginAddress

            // Override TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync to always return true for testing

            {
                return Task.FromResult(true);
            }

            // Override TakeCheckpointAsync to simulate checkpointing
            public override Task<(long? storeTailAddress, long? objectStoreTailAddress)> TakeCheckpointAsync(GarnetDatabase db, ILogger logger = null, CancellationToken token = default)
            {
                return Task.FromResult<(long?, long?)>((123, 456));
            }
        }

        private class TestTsavoriteLog : TsavoriteLog
        {
            private readonly long tailAddress;
            private readonly long beginAddress;

            public TestTsavoriteLog(long tailAddress, long beginAddress)

                this.beginAddress = beginAddress;
            }

            public override Task CommitAsync(CancellationToken token = default)

                TailAddress = 100,
                BeginAddress = 0

            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();

            // Act

        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsInformation_WhenAofSizeExceedsLimit()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();

            // We cannot instantiate SingleDatabaseManager directly because it is internal,
            // so we test the logging call by invoking the extension method on ILogger directly.
            // This is a minimal test to cover the LogInformation call usage.

            var aofSize = 100L;
            var aofSizeLimit = 50L;

            // Act
            loggerMock.Object.LogInformation(
                "Enforcing AOF size limit currentAofSize: {aofSize} >  AofSizeLimit: {aofSizeLimit}",
                aofSize, aofSizeLimit);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Enforcing AOF size limit")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, System.Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
